definitions.definition: (transitive) To render unable to move; to immobilize.

quote.citation: 2006, The H. P. Lovecraft Historical Society, “Harley Got Devoured by the Undead”, in An Even Scarier Solstice:
quote.text: So I stood alone in horror / Paralyzed with fear and dread / When a voice dead and inhuman / Whispered to me "go, you fool, Warren's dead!"

definitions.definition: (transitive) To render unable to function properly.
